Our little corner of the coast

Where we’re staying

01 · Our baseVilanova i la Geltrú02 · SitgesBeach & old town03 · BarcelonaOptional day out

West to east along the coast. Route sketch, not to scale. Tap a stop for its map.

Hotel, airport & train routes

Atenea Park is in Vilanova i la Geltrú, not Sitges town. Ribes Roges beach is nearby. Allow roughly 20–30 minutes to walk to Vilanova station, then about 5–10 minutes on R2 Sud to Sitges. These are planning estimates, plus waiting time.

From BCN Terminal 2, take R2 Nord to El Prat de Llobregat, then change to a westbound R2 Sud calling at Vilanova. Allow around 60–90 minutes for the rail journey including the change, plus arrival formalities and getting to the hotel. Check the actual service before setting off.

Hotel websiteHotel → SitgesAirport → hotelAirport train information

An optional Sunday switch

A day in Barcelona?

We can swap our Sunday in Sitges for a city day. A bit of Gaudí, a long lunch and a wander through the old streets.

Getting there & back

R2 Sud from Vilanova to Barcelona Passeig de Gràcia. Allow about 50–65 minutes on the train, or around 40–50 from Sitges, plus time to reach the station and wait. These are planning ranges, not booked services.

Check the dated timetable and service alerts before travelling. Head back from Passeig de Gràcia on an R2 Sud that calls at Vilanova i la Geltrú. Aim to leave around 18:00–19:00 rather than relying on the last train.

R2 Sud & service informationCurrent timetableLive route from our hotel
  1. 10:30 · Suggested startPasseig de Gràcia & Casa Batlló

    Coffee and a look at the buildings from outside. Allow an hour. An interior visit needs its own ticket and more time.

  2. 12:00 · A wander southGothic Quarter & Sant Felip Neri

    Take the smaller streets around the cathedral. Roughly 25–35 minutes’ walk from Passeig de Gràcia, with stops along the way.

  3. 13:30 · Lunch, no rushEl Born

    Find lunch around the Born, then browse the little streets. Leave ourselves a proper break.

  4. 15:30 · If we feel like itParc de la Ciutadella

    A sit-down in the park before heading back. Or skip this and stay for another coffee.

Fancy Sagrada Família instead?

Swap the morning architecture walk for Sagrada Família. Book a timed visit directly and allow extra time for the metro. Keep the afternoon shorter.
